scope: Phase 0-2; all new selection on previously used dev1 only
resource_accounting: Conservative process wall seconds times visible allocated GPUs, including pilots and failed runs. CPU-only jobs report CPU wall separately.
epsilon3_note: Primary reproduction uses serialized exact final value; report .102 nominal separately, never silently substitute.

primary.support_draws: existing distinct audited R5 draws, common to every method
primary.stream_images: all existing dev1 stream images; exact cached TINS order
primary.classwise: all 900 ID classes, chunked FP64 convergence; max_c U_c; same four score transformations
primary.frozen_CDF: Per draw/view/solver, CDF of the same 4 calibration images/class on the support+calibration graph before any stream arrival; frozen thereafter; no extra labels.

metrics.FPR95: At least 95% ID accepted; accept score >= lower empirical quantile; all threshold ties accepted; no interpolation; actual acceptance and tie counts recorded.
metrics.AUROC: ID-positive average ranks for ties; sklearn roc_auc_score
metrics.macro: Existing dev near contains 100 unknown ImageNet classes in one mixed stream, far OpenImage-O val; not OpenOOD test macro.
metrics.CI: Paired differences, average three orders within each support/calibration draw, 95% t interval df=4. Fixed image/class population. Exploratory dev intervals, no confirmatory claim.
metrics.confirmation_reserved: 10 genuinely distinct support/calibration draws x3 orders; not run/opened now; two tests candidate-vs-strongest LP and candidate-vs-no-entrance, Holm.

selection: dev1 minimum near FPR95 subject to far worsening <= .5 percentage points; -2 point near improvement is an exploratory target, not acceptance criterion or promise.

equal_additional_tuning_budget.note: Prior REPRISE and baseline search disclosed separately. No outcome-driven extension. All 3 configurations evaluated on the same 15 draw/order pairs if budget permits; incomplete families cannot be called tuned strongest.

simulation.generator: unit-normalized Gaussian class means (seeded); feature = mean + N(0,.3^2 I); equal ID mixture; OOD means independent; no image duplication.
simulation.iid_cal: 100 independent ID draws from the equal mixture; role masks every fourth iid draw; separate balanced condition uses 4/class.
simulation.unit: independently regenerated support/calibration/stream, not individual images

real_calibration.calibration_pool: 68 remaining R5 shot images/class; 4 sampled without replacement/class each replicate
real_calibration.stream: preexisting audited dev1 train audit subset: 4500 ID +1500 near OOD; ID-only and mixed and class-burst conditions
real_calibration.unit: calibration resample; stream cohort fixed; no binomial independence claim

stop: All preregistered required Phase0-2 work complete, or explicit budget/data obstacle; never stop/search based on favorable outcomes.
